description: This file defines a page component for a shop's payment detail view in a Next.js application. It includes static route parameters and a React server component that renders a client-side payment detail component.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters for different shop and payment IDs based on predefined seed data.

methods.name: ShopPaymentDetailPage
methods.description: Server component that fetches parameters, decodes them, and renders the PaymentDetailClient component with the decoded IDs.
